meta.note: Compiled from public defence-news reporting, Wikipedia, and HAL statements available as of Aug 2026. Program timelines in this sector shift frequently -- treat dates as directional, not contractual, and re-verify before citing to a panel.

items.purpose: Loyal-wingman unmanned combat air vehicle (UCAV) for manned-unmanned teaming
items.status: Full-scale airframe engine-integrated, ground runs completed; MUM-T datalink checks ongoing; first flight targeted 2027
items.engine: Turbojet/turbofan (integration confirmed by HAL CMD, 2026; exact engine not publicly finalized)
items.mission: Escort/strike alongside Tejas fighters, MUM-T control from up to ~150 km
items.platform: Unmanned combat air vehicle, part of Combat Air Teaming System (CATS)
items.description: HAL's flagship loyal-wingman program, designed to fly alongside a Tejas 'mothership' for scouting, decoy, and strike roles.

items.purpose: High-altitude long-endurance stealth UCAV / strategic strike asset
items.status: Preliminary design phase; government approval expected 2026; first flight projected 2030-32
items.engine: Not yet finalized (larger jet-class engine required)
items.mission: Counter high-altitude adversary UAVs, strategic ISR/strike, stealth bomber-gap coverage
items.power_generation: Single jet engine, larger thrust class than the 1-tonne variant
items.description: Positions HAL against systems like Boeing's MQ-28 Ghost Bat and China's GJ-11 in the emerging loyal-wingman/stealth-UCAV category.

items.status: Prototype flight testing; HAL manufacturing first production batch; 76 units planned across Army (60), Air Force (12), Navy (4)
items.engine: Piston/turbo engine (twin-engine derivative of Rustom-1 airframe)
items.mission: ISR (intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance); demonstrated altitude ~27,500 ft, endurance ~18 hrs, payload up to 350 kg
items.description: DRDO/ADE-designed MALE UAV with HAL as production partner; directly comparable in mission profile to GARUN's PS1 hybrid-electric MALE UAV target class.

items.purpose: Armed MALE UAV derived from the Rustom-1 airframe
items.status: Development stage; BEL selected as L1 bidder for manufacturing/assembly of initial units
items.mission: Armed ISR strike; payload up to 300 kg, service ceiling ~30,000 ft; planned integration of laser-guided rockets, bombs, loitering munitions
technology: Shared DRDO/ADE ground control station with TAPAS-BH-201
items.power_generation: Turbojet (Archer SR-UAV lineage) / turboprop-class for NG variant
items.description: Positioned by the Ministry of Defence as complementary to imported MALE UAV procurement, alongside TAPAS-BH-201.

items.purpose: Baseline tactical UAV; precursor airframe for the Rustom/TAPAS/Archer family
items.status: Prototype flight testing complete; superseded operationally by TAPAS-BH-201 and Archer-NG derivatives
items.mission: Tactical ISR; endurance ~10 hrs, range ~200 km, altitude up to 20,000 ft
technology: Derived from Rutan Long-EZ airframe concept
items.description: The foundational airframe from which TAPAS-BH-201, Archer, and Archer-NG were all developed.

items.purpose: Stealth unmanned combat air vehicle (flying-wing UCAV)
items.status: Development stage; propulsion certification (Kaveri dry-derivative engine) targeted late 2026
items.description: India's most ambitious indigenous stealth-UCAV effort, notable for reviving the Kaveri engine program as a dry (non-afterburning) unmanned-platform powerplant rather than for the manned-fighter role it originally targeted.

items.purpose: Large-scale MALE UAV acquisition combining imports and indigenous complementary platforms
items.status: Active vendor competition, ~24 vendors competing as of early 2026 reporting
items.mission: Persistent ISR and armed MALE capability at scale
items.description: The indigenous TAPAS-BH-201 and Archer-NG programs are positioned by the Ministry of Defence as complementary to this larger procurement effort, not substitutes for it -- directly relevant context for PS1's own MALE-class hybrid-electric propulsion framing.
